subject: Post-demo: POC success map and model runbook (next steps)
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finserve.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks — quick recap & attachment

Aditya / team,

Thanks for the demo today — good overview. Attached is our internal draft of POC success criteria (POC-Success-Criteria-v2.xlsx). A couple of clarifying points from our side: 

- Primary goal: reduce average time-to-resolution on chat cases by 30% for English + Spanish support flows.
- Secondary: reasonable cost per token for peak hours (we gave a rough budget range during the call).
- Must-have security items: audit logs retention for 12 months; customer data must not be used to train models.

Next steps from our side: connect procurement for standard SOW and budget approval (cc'd procurement@finserve.com). From Redwood, we asked for a concrete POC plan with measurable acceptance criteria, model recommendation(s), timeline, and clear owners. 

Can you send a one-pager POC runbook and who will own which pieces? Happy to run a short alignment meeting next week if needed.

Thanks — Alex

Alex Johnson
Head of Digital Operations
FinServe, Inc.

Attachments: POC-Success-Criteria-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet summarizing metrics)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finserve.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick recap & attachment

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We captured the ask and sketched a concise POC success map + model runbook below (high level). I attached a draft SOW (redwood-poc-sow-2027.pdf) and added a Drive link with the evaluation rubric.

POC success map (4 weeks preferred):
- Success metric A (primary): Reduce contact-center chat avg time-to-resolution by >= 30% on English + Spanish flows measured on sample set (pre/post A/B). owner: FinServe + Redwood (see owners).
- Success metric B (secondary): Bot answer precision >= 78% on a 500-sample verification set. owner: FinServe QA + Redwood ML.
- SLOs: p50 latency <= 350ms; p95 <= 900ms for 8k token contexts.
- Security/compliance: Audit logs exported daily; session tokens scoped and rotatable; confirm no training on customer data during POC.
- Cost guardrail: target inference unit cost under $0.025 per 1k tokens (configurable via batching/quantization).

Model recommendation for the trial:
- Primary candidate (open model): OpenLlama-3-7B-quant, selected for cost/perf balance and proven Spanish coverage in our benchmarks.
- Fallback candidate: Llama-2-13B-chat (quant variant) to use when higher fidelity is required for complex dialogs.
- If FinServe requires higher hallucination control, we can stage a second week using a tuned Llama-2-13B snapshot.

Multilingual plan:
- Training prompts + small eval sets for English, Spanish, Portuguese. We propose sample ratios: 60% EN, 30% ES, 10% PT.

Evaluation plan / artifacts:
- Shared eval rubric (Drive) with exact pass/fail thresholds and sample IDs.
- Weekly artifact delivery: metrics dashboard, sample transcripts, error taxonomy.

Timeline / milestones (target):
- Day 0 (kickoff): confirm owners, SOW signed, access & network checklist.
- Week 1: integration (API keys, VPC peering for Private), baseline collection.
- Week 2: initial model runs + evaluation tests.
- Week 3: tuning & remediation.
- Week 4: acceptance testing & closeout.

Owner assignments (Redwood/FinServe):
- DRI (Redwood): Aditya Rao — overall technical delivery & escalation.
- Implementation lead (Redwood): Monica Patel — integration, infra, environment setup.
- Evaluation/metrics (Redwood): Karthik Iyer — evaluation harness, dashboards, sample sets.
- FinServe DRI: Alex Johnson — business signoff & acceptance, procurement liaison: Sara Lim.

Open asks from Redwood to FinServe (please action before kickoff):
1) Procurement review and signature on the SOW (we attached redwood-poc-sow-2027.pdf).
2) Provide one technical contact for network/VPN setup (for our VPC/private path).
3) Share a 500-row sample of anonymized transcripts (we will treat as PII-managed).

If that outline looks good I can send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff. If you'd like different models on the shortlist (we can add Anthropic-like open variants), say so and we'll include quick perf estimates.

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-2027.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/FinServe-POC
